Below is a chronological **list of school attacks in China**.

On March 23, 2010, Zheng Minsheng (郑民生)[39] 41, murdered eight children with a knife in an elementary school in Nanping,[40]Fujian province;[41] The attack was widely reported in Chinese media (called 南平实验小学重大凶杀案),[39] sparking fears of copycat crimes.
[41] Following a quick trial, Zheng Minsheng was executed about one month later on April 28.
[40] Media reported a history of mental health issues, but police stated that Zheng had no history of mental illness, contradicting earlier reports.
Zheng said that he performed the attack after being turned down by a girl and suffering "unfair treatment" from the girl's wealthy family.

Eight children, between the ages of three and five,[56] were injured in Minhang District, Shanghai, when an employee at a child-care centre for migrant workers slashed the children with a box-cutter.[57] The woman had worked there for years, but was thought to have psychiatric problems.
On June 15, 2017, a bombing at a kindergarten in Feng County, Xuzhou, Jiangsu province, east China, killed at least eight people and injured 65 others.
The perpetrator, 22-year-old Xu Taoran, died in the blast.

Subsequent investigation revealed that Xu had been mentally ill and was obsessed with death and destruction.[90] The blast occurred at the entrance of the kindergarten, while children were leaving school.
Two people died on the spot, and five succumbed to injuries at the hospital.
Nine remained in critical condition in the aftermath.[91] Due to the shattering bomb parts, over 60 people were injured and needed medical attention.
